MAX(CASE WHEN bills.service_id = 1 THEN bills.amt END) AS regFee, bills.charge_per_unit AS consFee,
bills.discount AS consDiscount, bills.discount_amt AS consDiscountAmount, bill.tot_amt AS totAmt, bills.cons_final_amount AS consamount, bill.bill_amt as billAmt, bill.auth_person as disStaffId, bill.tot_discount AS totDiscount, bill.tot_dis_per AS totDiscountAmt, bill.tot_retd_amt AS amtRecd, bill.balance AS balance, bill.disc_remarks as remarks, ss.source_service_id AS sourceServiceId, a.visit_type AS visitTypeId , (SELECT SUM(a.amount) FROM at_receipt_mode a,at_bills b WHERE b.bill_id=a.bill_id and a.service_id = 1 and a.payment_type=275 AND b.patient_category=4 and
DATE(b.bill_dt) BETWEEN DATE_FORMAT(STR_TO_DATE(#{apptFromDate}, '%e-%b-%Y'), '%Y-%m-%d') and DATE_FORMAT(STR_TO_DATE(#{apptToDate}, '%e-%b-%Y'), '%Y-%m-%d')
date(b.bill_dt) = CURDATE()
) AS regAmoCash, (SELECT SUM(a.amount) FROM at_receipt_mode a,at_bills b WHERE b.bill_id=a.bill_id and a.service_id = 1 and a.payment_type=276 and b.patient_category=4 and
DATE(b.bill_dt) BETWEEN DATE_FORMAT(STR_TO_DATE(#{apptFromDate}, '%e-%b-%Y'), '%Y-%m-%d') and DATE_FORMAT(STR_TO_DATE(#{apptToDate}, '%e-%b-%Y'), '%Y-%m-%d')
date(b.bill_dt) = CURDATE()
) AS regAmoCard, (SELECT SUM(a.amount) FROM at_receipt_mode a,at_bills b WHERE b.bill_id=a.bill_id and a.service_id = 1 and a.payment_type=277 and b.patient_category=4 and
DATE(b.bill_dt) BETWEEN DATE_FORMAT(STR_TO_DATE(#{apptFromDate}, '%e-%b-%Y'), '%Y-%m-%d') and DATE_FORMAT(STR_TO_DATE(#{apptToDate}, '%e-%b-%Y'), '%Y-%m-%d')
date(b.bill_dt) = CURDATE()
) AS regAmoUpi, (SELECT SUM(a.amount) FROM at_receipt_mode a,at_bills b WHERE b.bill_id=a.bill_id and a.service_id = 2 and a.payment_type=275 AND b.patient_category=4 and a.status_id=34 and
DATE(b.bill_dt) BETWEEN DATE_FORMAT(STR_TO_DATE(#{apptFromDate}, '%e-%b-%Y'), '%Y-%m-%d') and DATE_FORMAT(STR_TO_DATE(#{apptToDate}, '%e-%b-%Y'), '%Y-%m-%d')
date(b.bill_dt) = CURDATE()
) AS conAmoCash, (SELECT SUM(a.amount) FROM at_receipt_mode a,at_bills b WHERE b.bill_id=a.bill_id and a.service_id = 2 and a.payment_type=276 AND b.patient_category=4 and a.status_id=34 and
DATE(b.bill_dt) BETWEEN DATE_FORMAT(STR_TO_DATE(#{apptFromDate}, '%e-%b-%Y'), '%Y-%m-%d') and DATE_FORMAT(STR_TO_DATE(#{apptToDate}, '%e-%b-%Y'), '%Y-%m-%d')
date(b.bill_dt) = CURDATE()
) AS conAmoCard, (SELECT SUM(a.amount) FROM at_receipt_mode a,at_bills b WHERE b.bill_id=a.bill_id and a.service_id = 2 and a.payment_type=277 AND b.patient_category=4 and a.status_id=34 and
DATE(b.bill_dt) BETWEEN DATE_FORMAT(STR_TO_DATE(#{apptFromDate}, '%e-%b-%Y'), '%Y-%m-%d') and DATE_FORMAT(STR_TO_DATE(#{apptToDate}, '%e-%b-%Y'), '%Y-%m-%d')
date(b.bill_dt) = CURDATE()
) AS conAmoUpi, (SELECT SUM(b.paid_amt) FROM at_bills b WHERE b.patient_category=4 and
DATE(b.bill_dt) BETWEEN DATE_FORMAT(STR_TO_DATE(#{apptFromDate}, '%e-%b-%Y'), '%Y-%m-%d') and DATE_FORMAT(STR_TO_DATE(#{apptToDate}, '%e-%b-%Y'), '%Y-%m-%d')
date(b.bill_dt) = CURDATE()
) AS paidAmt, (SELECT SUM(a.refund_amt) FROM at_op_bill_refund a,at_bills b WHERE b.bill_id=a.bill_id and b.patient_category=4 and
DATE(b.bill_dt) BETWEEN DATE_FORMAT(STR_TO_DATE(#{apptFromDate}, '%e-%b-%Y'), '%Y-%m-%d') and DATE_FORMAT(STR_TO_DATE(#{apptToDate}, '%e-%b-%Y'), '%Y-%m-%d')
date(b.bill_dt) = CURDATE()
) AS refundAmt FROM patient_last_1_year p LEFT JOIN appt_last_1_year a ON p.patient_id = a.patient_id LEFT JOIN at_location l ON l.loc_id = a.loc_id LEFT JOIN at_source_service ss ON p.emp_id = ss.equp_service_id LEFT JOIN at_source_service_consult ssc ON ss.source_service_id = ssc.source_service_id AND ssc.visit_type_id = a.visit_type LEFT JOIN at_bills bill ON bill.patient_id = p.patient_id LEFT JOIN at_cb_tariff tar ON tar.tariff_id = bill.patient_category LEFT JOIN at_pr_visits am ON am.patient_appt_id = a.patient_appt_id LEFT JOIN at_bill_details bd ON bill.bill_id = bd.bill_id and bd.patient_appt_id = a.patient_appt_id LEFT JOIN at_hr_emp e ON bill.emp_id = e.emp_id LEFT JOIN at_bill_details bills ON bills.patient_appt_id = a.patient_appt_id LEFT JOIN at_hr_specialization spec ON e.spec_id = spec.spec_id

SELECT p.patient_id AS patientId,a.patient_appt_id AS apptId,DATE_FORMAT(a.schedule_dt, '%d-%b-%Y') AS apptDt, CONCAT(l.loc_name) AS location, a.loc_id AS locId,l.loc_name AS locName, p.patient_name AS patientName,p.gender AS gender,p.mob_num AS mobNum,p.umr_num AS patientCode,p.age AS age, p.age_d AS ageDays,p.age_m AS ageMonths, fn_getcodevalue(a.appt_status_id) AS statusInfo,a.op_num AS opCode,a.start_time AS startTime,e.emp_id AS empId, p.state AS state,p.city AS city,p.village AS village FROM at_pr_patient p,at_pr_appt a,at_hr_emp e,at_location l WHERE p.patient_id = a.patient_id AND a.emp_id = e.emp_id AND p.status_id = 34 AND l.loc_id = '1'

SELECT p.patient_id AS patientId, a.patient_appt_id AS apptId, p.last_name AS lName, a.vital_status as vitalStatus, p.patient_name AS pname, CONCAT(l.loc_name) AS location, a.loc_id AS locId, l.loc_name AS locName, fn_getcodevalue(a.bill_status) AS billStatus, p.umr_num AS patientCode, a.priority_no AS priorityNo, CONCAT(p.patient_name, ' ', COALESCE(p.last_name, '')) AS patientName, p.gender AS gender, p.blood_grp AS bloodGrp, p.mob_num AS mobNum, p.age AS age, p.title AS ptitle, p.age_d AS ageDays, p.age_m AS ageMonths, p.location_id AS locationId, p.parent_name AS parentName, p.care_by AS careBy, p.care_by_name AS careByName, p.patient_category_name AS pntCat, fn_getcodevalue(a.appt_status_id) AS statusInfo, a.op_num AS opCode, a.start_time AS startTime, tar.r_chart_name AS patientCategory, e.emp_id AS empId, CONCAT(e.emp_id, ':', e.emp_code, ':', spec.spec_name) AS employeeId, p.state AS state, p.city AS city, p.village AS village, p.addr AS addr, p.marital_status AS maritalStatus, p.religion AS religion, p.id_proof_type AS idProofType, p.id_proof_num AS idProofNum, p.occupation AS occupation, a.ref_type AS refType, p.org_id AS orgId, p.sms_status AS smsStatus, p.sms_alert AS smsAlert, p.dob AS dob, p.ref_id AS refId, p.patient_category AS patientCategoryId, fn_getcodevalue(a.visit_type) AS visitType, CONCAT(e.emp_name, ' ', COALESCE(e.last_name, '')) AS docName, p.nationality AS nationality, a.diseases_desc AS problem, a.token_num AS tokenNum, DATE_FORMAT(a.schedule_dt, '%d-%b-%Y') AS apptDt, am.visit_id AS visitId, a.added_by AS addedBy, a.other_staff_id AS otherStaffId, a.other_hosp_id AS otherhospId,
-- Registration payment details (only if service_id = 1) COALESCE(SUM(DISTINCT CASE WHEN pc.service_id = 1 AND pc.payment_type = 275 THEN pc.amount ELSE 0 END), 0) AS regOpCashAmt, COALESCE(SUM(DISTINCT CASE WHEN pc.service_id = 1 AND pc.payment_type = 276 THEN pc.amount ELSE 0 END), 0) AS regOpCreditAmt, COALESCE(SUM(DISTINCT CASE WHEN pc.service_id = 1 AND pc.payment_type = 277 THEN pc.amount ELSE 0 END), 0) AS regOpUpiAmt,
-- Consultation payment details (only if service_id = 2) COALESCE(SUM(DISTINCT CASE WHEN pc.service_id = 2 AND pc.payment_type = 275 THEN pc.amount ELSE 0 END), 0) AS cashAmt, COALESCE(SUM(DISTINCT CASE WHEN pc.service_id = 2 AND pc.payment_type = 276 THEN pc.amount ELSE 0 END), 0) AS creditAmt, COALESCE(SUM(DISTINCT CASE WHEN pc.service_id = 2 AND pc.payment_type = 277 THEN pc.amount ELSE 0 END), 0) AS upiAmt,
bill.bill_id AS billId, bill.authorized_by as authorizedBy, ss.source_service_id AS sourceServiceId, a.visit_type AS visitTypeId
FROM patient_last_1_month p LEFT JOIN appt_last_1_month a ON p.patient_id = a.patient_id LEFT JOIN at_hr_emp e ON a.emp_id = e.emp_id LEFT JOIN at_location l ON l.loc_id = a.loc_id LEFT JOIN at_hr_specialization spec ON e.spec_id = spec.spec_id LEFT JOIN at_cb_tariff tar ON tar.tariff_id = p.patient_category LEFT JOIN at_source_service ss ON p.emp_id = ss.equp_service_id LEFT JOIN at_source_service_consult ssc ON ss.source_service_id = ssc.source_service_id AND ssc.visit_type_id = a.visit_type LEFT JOIN at_bills bill ON bill.patient_id = p.patient_id LEFT JOIN at_pr_visits am ON am.patient_appt_id = a.patient_appt_id LEFT JOIN at_receipt_mode pc ON bill.bill_id = pc.bill_id WHERE
date(a.schedule_dt) between DATE_FORMAT(STR_TO_DATE(#{apptFromDate}, '%e-%b-%Y'), '%Y-%m-%d') and DATE_FORMAT(STR_TO_DATE(#{apptToDate}, '%e-%b-%Y'), '%Y-%m-%d') and p.patient_category=4 and p.status_id = 34
date(a.schedule_dt) = DATE_FORMAT(STR_TO_DATE(#{apptFromDate}, '%e-%b-%Y'), '%Y-%m-%d') and p.patient_category=4 and p.status_id = 34
DATE_FORMAT(STR_TO_DATE(#{apptToDate}, '%e-%b-%Y'), '%Y-%m-%d') and p.patient_category=4 and p.status_id = 34
date(a.schedule_dt) = CURDATE() and p.patient_category=4 and p.status_id = 34
and a.loc_id=#{locId}
GROUP BY p.patient_id, bill.bill_id, a.patient_appt_id, a.visit_type order by bill.bill_id DESC
